invariants.rationale: The method always returns either fileId (which may be non-null) or the result of BulkInsertPartitioner.super.getFileIdPfx(partitionId), which is expected to be non-null.
If fileId is not null, result returns fileId.
If fileId is null, result comes from BulkInsertPartitioner.super.getFileIdPfx(partitionId).
Likely, valid partitionId produces a non-empty prefix string.
